name: plus
description: Represents adding or creating. On hover the vertical bar inscribes itself top to bottom over the stationary horizontal bar.

animation.description: The vertical bar draws itself top to bottom (pathLength 0 to 1, 0.25s draw ease) while the horizontal bar stays fixed — the addition inscribed. One-shot, ends at rest. Reduced motion: static.

accessibility.notes: Provide context for what is being added when used in a button.
